senses.gloss: शम—नीच-मेढ्र m. one whose generative organ hangs down from absence of passion or impotence, TāṇḍBr.
शमान्तक m. ‘destroyer of tranquillity’, N. of Kāma-deva (god of love), L.
शमान्वित mfn. devoted to quietism, MuṇḍUp.
सम्-अन्वित mfn. connected or associated with, completely possessed of, fully endowed with, possessing, full of (instr. or comp.), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
corresponding or answering to (comp.), R.
शमन mf(ई)n. calming, tranquillizing, soothing, allaying, extinguishing, destroying, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
शमन m. ‘settler, destroyer’, N. of Yama, Daś.
a kind of antelope, L.
a kind of pea, L.
शमन n. the act of calming, appeasing, allaying, tranquillization, pacification, extinction, destruction, Kauś.; MBh. &c. killing, slaying, immolation, Kauś.
chewing, swallowing, L.
a mode of sipping water (prob. for चमन), MW.
malediction, reviling (w.r. for शपन), W.
शामन mfn. extinguishing, destroying, Pañcat. iii, 31 (v.l. for शमन)
शामन m. N. of Yama (= शमन), W.
शामन n. a sedative, Car.
tranquillity, peace, W.
killing, slaughter, ib.
end (˚नं-√ या, to go to an end, be destroyed), MW.
सम्-आन॑ m. (for समान and स-मान See p. 1160) one of the five vital airs (that which circulates about the navel and is essential to digestion; it is personified as a son of Sādhya), AV.; &c.

समान॑ mf(ई॑, or आ)n. (connected with 1. and 2. सम; in RV. v, 87, 4 abl. sg. समान॑स्मात् for समाना॑त् See 1. सम; for सम्-अन See सम्-√ अन्, for स-मान See col. 3) same, identical, uniform, one (= एक, L.), RV. &c. &c.
alike, similar, equal (in size, age, rank, sense or meaning &c.), equal or like to (with instr., gen., or comp.), VS. &c. &c.
having the same place or organ of utterance, homogeneous (as a sound or letter), Vop.
holding the middle between two extremes, middling moderate, BhP.
common, general, universal, all, RV.; Br.; ŚrS.; BhP.
whole (as a number, opp. to ‘a fraction’), Pāṇ. v, 2, 47, Vārtt. 4
being (= सत्, after an adj.), Divyāv.
virtuous, good, L.
= वर्ण-भिद्, L.
समान॑ m. an equal, friend, TBr.; Cāṇ.; BhP.
समान॑ (prob.) n. N. of wk. (cf. शाखा-स्˚).
1. स-मान mfn. (for समान See col. 1; for सम्-आन See p. 1154, col. 2) possessing honour or esteem, honoured by (gen.), Vet.
with anger, BhP.
2. स-मान mfn. (for 1. See above) having the same measure, L.
स॑मन n. (prob. connected with 2. सम्, or 2. सम) meeting (cf. अ-समन॑), assembly, concourse, festival, RV.; AV.
intercourse, commerce, pursuit, RV. i, 48, 6
amorous union, embrace, RV. vi, 75, 4 &c.
conflict, strife, ib. vi, 73, 3; 5 &c. (Naigh. ii, 17).
समना॑ ind. in one point, together, RV.
at a time, all at once, ib.
likewise, uniformly, ib.
1. सम्-मान m. or (accord. to some) n. (for 2. See col. 2) honour, respect, homage, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
2. सम्-मान n. (for 1. See सम्-√ मन्) the act of measuring out, equalizing, comparing, MW.
measure, ib.
1. 2. सम्-मान See सम्-√ मन् and सम्- √ 3. मा, col. 1.
1. सामन mf(आ)n. (for 2. See under 2. सामन्) rich, affluent, abundant (others ‘common, universal’), RV. iii, 30, 9.
2. सामन॑ mfn. (for 1. See under 1. सामन्) quiet, calm, RV. x, 85, 9.
सामान Vṛddhi form of 2. समान in comp.
शमनी f. See below
शमनी f. ‘the calming one’, night, L.
शामनी (ई), f. the southern quarter, L.
समानी॑ (ई), f. a kind of metre, Piṅg.
सामनी f. (cf. साम्नी) a rope or cord for tying cattle (v.l. दामनी), L.
शमन—विधि m. N. of the 46th Pariśiṣṭa of the AV.
शमन—श्वसृ f. ‘Yama's sister’, the river Yamunā or Jumnā, L.
शमनी—पार m. (prob.) a partic. mode of reciting the Ṛg-veda, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 2, 1, Vārtt. 1.
शमनी—षद m. ‘night-goer’, a Rākṣasa, evil spirit, demon, L.
शमनीय mfn. to be tranquillized, consolable, MW.
serving for tranquillization, soothing, Suśr.
शमनीय n. a sedative, ib.; Sāh.
शमन्तक-स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra, Cat. (prob. w.r. for शमान्तक-, or स्यमन्तक-स्त्˚).
शामन् n. (cf. सामन्) appeasing, reconciling, conciliation, W.
सम्-√ अन् P. -अनिति, to breathe, live, RV.
1. सा॑मन् n. (fr. √ 1. सा = 1. सन्) acquisition, possession, property, wealth, abundance, RV.; VS.

2. सा॑मन् n. (m. only in TBr.; prob. connected with √ सान्त्व्; accord. to some fr. √ 1. सा; cf. 3. सामन्) calming, tranquillizing, (esp.) kind or gentle words for winning an adversary, conciliation, negotiation (one of the 4 Upāyas or means of success against an enemy, the other 3 being दान, भेद, and दण्ड, qq.vv.; ibc. or instr. sg. and pl., ‘by friendly means or in a friendly way, willingly, voluntarily’), TBr.; &c.

3. सा॑मन् n. (of doubtful derivation; accord. to Uṇ. iv, 152 fr. √ सो = 2. सा, as ‘destroying sin’; in Nir. vii, 12 apparently connected with सम्मित; by others derived fr. √ 1. सन्, सा, सान्त्व्, and perhaps not to be separated fr. 1. and 2. सामन्) a metrical hymn or song of praise, (esp.) a partic. kind of sacred text or verse called a Sāman (intended to be chanted, and forming, with ऋच्, यजुस्, छन्दस्, one of the 4 kinds of Vedic composition mentioned first in RV. x, 90, 9), RV. &c. &c.
any song or tune (sacred or profane, also the hum of bees), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the faculty of uttering sounds (?), TBr. (Sch.)
सम—नर m. = -शङ्कु, Gol.; Gaṇit.
सम—निन्दा-नवन mf(आ)n. indifferent to blame and praise, Nalod.
समांश m. an equal share (as in an inheritance; ˚शेन ind. ‘in eq˚ sh˚’), Kathās.; Vajracch.
समांश mfn. containing equal parts, Suśr.
entitled to or obtaining an eq˚ sh˚, Mn. ix, 157
समांश &c. See p. 1153, col. 1
समांशा (आ), f. Sida Cordifolia, L.
स-मांस mfn. connected or combined with meat, containing meat, fleshy, R.; VarBṛS. &c.
समांशेन (एन), ind., ‘in eq˚ sh˚’
समांश—भागिन् mfn. sharing in equal portions, L.
समांश—हारिन् mfn. taking an eq˚ port˚, sharing equally, a co-heir, Dāyat.
समांशक mf(इका)n. obtaining an eq˚ share, ib.; Yājñ.
समांशिक mfn. consisting of equal parts, Suśr.
entitled to an equal share, MW.
समांशिन् mfn. obtaining an equal sh˚, Yājñ.; Dāyat.
समानन mfn. (for स-मानन See s.v.) having a like face with (instr.), Nalod.
स-मानन mfn. (for समानन See p. 1153, col. 1) being in honour or respect, Nalod.
सम्-अनन n. breathing together, Nir.
सम्-˚मानन n. (or f(आ). ; fr. Caus.) the act of honouring, worshipping, homage, Nir.; Pāṇ.; MBh. &c.
1. स॑मान्त m. (for 2. समान्त See under समा) a borderer, neighbour, MaitrS. (cf. स॑मन्त).
2. समा˚न्त (˚मान्˚), m. (for 1. समान्˚ See under 2. सम, col. 1) the end of a year, ib. iv, 26.
समान्त , समान्तर. See p. 1153, cols. 1 and 2.
स॑म्-अन्त mf(आ)n. ‘having the ends together’, contiguous, neighbouring, adjacent, RV.; AV.; PañcavBr.

‘being on every side’, universal, whole, entire, all (स॑मन्तम् ind. ‘in contiguity or conjunction with’, ‘together with’; समन्त॑म् ind. or ˚तात् ind. or ˚त-तस् ind. ‘on all sides, around’, ‘or, wholly, completely’; ˚तेन ind. ‘all round’; with न = ‘nowhere’), AV. &c. &c.
स॑म्-अन्त n. (also with अग्नेः, वरुणस्य, or वसिष्ठस्य) N. of various Samans, Br.
स॑म्-अन्त n. or m. (?) N. of a country, Buddh.
स॑म्-अन्ता (आ), f. (pl.) neighbourhood, ŚBr.
N. of a grammar, Col.
सामान्त m. the end of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
सामन्त mfn. (fr. सम्-अन्त) being on all sides, KātyŚr.
bordering, limiting, W.
सामन्त m. a neighbour, Kāṭh.; Mn.; Yājñ.
a vassal, feudatory prince, the chief of a district (paying tribute to a lord paramount), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a minister (?), Cāṇ. (v.l.)
a leader, general, captain, champion, W.
N. of the author of the Tājika-sāra-ṭīkā (1620 A.D.), Cat.
सामन्त n. a neighbourhood, Mn.; Śukas.
1. समान्तर mfn. (for 2. समान्त्˚ See under समा) being a constant unit of difference (in measurement; e.g. ‘if a man forms the unit, a horse is त्रि-समान्तर् अः i.e. = three men’), Kām.
parallel, A.
2. समा˚न्तर (˚मान्˚), n. (for 1. समान्˚ See col. 1) the interval of a y˚
सम्-अन्तर m. pl. N. of a people, MBh.
समा—निचय mfn. one who has a store (of provisions) sufficient for a year, Mn. vi, 18.
समा—˚न्तरे (ए), ind. within a y˚, Car.
समां-समीना f. (fr. समां समाम्) a cow bearing a calf every year, Pāṇ. v, 2, 12.
समन—ग॑ mfn. going to an assembly, RV.
समन्य᳙ mfn. fit for an assembly or for a festival (as a garment), RV.
समन्य᳙ See p. 1154, col. 2
समान्या॑ ind. equally, jointly, together, RV.; MaitrS.
सम्-˚मान्य mfn. to be (or being) highly honoured by (gen.), R.
1. सामन्य mfn. (for 2. see col. 2) friendly, favourable (in अ-स्˚, q.v.)
2. सामन्य᳙ mfn. (for 1. see col. 1) skilful in chanting or singing, RV.; Bhaṭṭ.
सामान्य mf(आ)n. equal, alike, similar, MBh.; Śak.
shared by others, joint, common to (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), Yājñ.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
whole, entire, universal, general, generic, not specific (opp. to वैशेषिक), Suśr.; VarBṛS.
common, common-place, vulgar, ordinary, insignificant, low, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सामान्य (अम्), n. equality, similarity, identity, MBh.; Suśr. &c.
equilibrium, normal state or condition, Nīlak.
universality, totality, generality, general or fundamental notion, common or generic property (ibc. instr., or abl., ‘in general’, as opp. to विशेष-तस्, ‘in particular’), Kaṇ.; Jaim.; Sarvad.
public affairs or business, W.
(in rhet.) the connection of different objects by common properties, Kpr.; Kuval.
सामान्या (आ), f. a common female, prostitute, L.
सम्-अनन्तर mf(आ)n. immediately contiguous to or following (abl. or gen.; यच्चात्र सम्-अनन्तरम्, ‘and what is immediately connected with it’), R.; BhP.; Sarvad.
सम्-अनन्तरम् (अम्), ind. immediately behind or after (gen. or abl. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
स॑-मनस् mfn. being of the same mind, unanimous, RV.; VS.; Kauś.
endowed with understanding, BhP.
स॑म्-मनस् mfn. unanimous, AV.; ŚBr.
स-मनस्क mfn. unanimous, KaṭhUp.; Sarvad.
सम्-अनीक॑ n. battle, war, RV. (Naigh. ii, 17), Bālar. vii, 60/61.
समानिका f. a kind of metre, Col.
सामानिक mfn. (fr. 2. समान) of equal rank or dignity with (gen. or comp.), HPariś.; Pañcad.
सम्-अनीक—तस् ind. in battle-array, AitBr.
सम्-अनीक—मूर्धन् m. the front of b˚-array, Vcar.
सम्-अनु-√ कम्प् Ā. -कम्पते, to sympathize with, have pity on (acc.), Ragh.
सम्-अनुकीर्तन n. praising highly, high praise, MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ कॢप् Caus. -कल्पयति, to make any one (acc.) attain to any state or condition (loc.), MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ क्रम् (only ind.p. -क्रम्य), to go or pass through completely, run through (acc.), BhP.

सम्-अनु-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go after, follow, pursue (acc.), R.;
to penetrate, pervade, MBh.
सम्-अनुगत mfn. gone after or through, followed, pervaded, Śaṃk.
coherent or connected with (instr.), ib.
सम्-अनु-√ गा (only aor. -अन्व्-अगात्), to go after together, follow quite closely, follow, MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ गै P. -गायति, to repeat in verse or metre, Car.

सम्-अनु-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, to collect or gather together, arrange or put in order, MBh.;
to show favour or grace to (acc.), Kām.
सम्-अनुग्राह्य mfn. to be favoured or treated graciously, Hariv.
सम्-अनु-√ चिन्त् P. -चिन्तयति, to reflect deeply about, meditate on, remember (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अनुज mfn. together with a younger brother, BhP.
सम्-अनु-√ जन् Ā. -जायते, to be born similar to or resembling (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अनुज्ञा f. leave, permission, L.
सम्-˚अनुज्ञात mfn. entirely consented or agreed to &c.
authorized, empowered, MBh.
allowed to go away, dismissed, ib.
favoured, treated kindly, ib.
सम्-˚अनुज्ञान mfn. entirely acquiesced in, permitted, allowed, W.
assent, permission, ib.
सम्-अनु-√ तप् Pass. -तप्यते, to suffer great subsequent pain, be very penitent, repent, MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to assign or apportion anything (acc.) to any one (dat.), AitBr.
सम्-अनु-√ दृश् See सम्-अनु√ पश्.
सम्-अनु-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to run after together, follow, pursue, MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ धाव् P. -धावति, to run after together, follow, pursue, MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ ध्यै P. -ध्यायति, to reflect upon, think of (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अनु-नि-√ शम् (only ind.p. -शम्य), to perceive, learn, R.
सम्-अनु-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते (ep. also P. ˚ति), to enter into or upon, attain to, MBh.; Hariv. (v.l. -वत्स्यति for -पत्स्यति).
सम्-अनु-√ पाल् P. -पालयति, to maintain or observe well, keep (a promise &c.), MBh.; R.
सम्-अनु-√ प्रछ् P. -पृच्छति, to ask or inquire about (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अनु-प्राप् (-प्र-√ आप्) P. -प्राप्नोति, to attain or reach or arrive at (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अनुप्राप्त mfn. come, arrived at, R.
one who has attained to (acc.), MBh.
obtained, assumed, MW.
entirely covered or overspread, ib.
सम्-अनुबन्ध m. = अनुबन्ध, L.
सम्-अनु-√ भू P. -भवति to enjoy together, feel, perceive, Ragh.

सम्-अनु-√ मन् Ā. -मन्यते, to assent, consent to (see next);
to recognize together as (acc.), Kām.
सम्-अनुमत mfn. consented to, agreed upon
सम्-अनुमत n. consent, AitBr.
सम्-अनु-√ या P. -याति, to go after, follow, MBh.; VarBṛS.
सम्-अनुयात mfn. gone after, followed, MBh.

सम्-अनु-√ युज् (only ind.p. -युज्य and Pass. -युज्यते), to inquire after, ask about, Cat.;
to appoint, order, enjoin, R.
सम्-अनुयोज्य mfn. to be combined or mixed with (instr.), VarBṛS.
सम्-अनु-वर्णित mfn. (√ वर्ण्) well described or narrated, explained, MBh.; BhP.
सम्-अनु-√ वस् P. -वसति, to abide by, follow, conform to (acc.), Hariv. (v.l. -पत्स्यति for -वत्स्यति).
सम्-अनु-√ 1. विद् Caus. -वेदयति, to cause to know or remember, remind, AitBr.
सम्-अनु-वीक्ष् (-वि-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -वीक्षते, to well observe, behold, Kāv.
सम्-अनुवर्तिन् mfn. obedient, willing, devoted to (gen.), R.
सम्-अनु-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to go after, follow or pursue with others, MBh.
सम्-अनुव्रत mf(आ)n. entirely devoted or attached to (acc.)

सम्-अनु-√ शास् P. -शास्ति, to teach thoroughly, instruct (two acc.), BhP.;
 (with राज्यम्, or राज्य-अक्ष्मीम्) to rule or regulate well, govern, MBh.; Inscr.
सम्-अनुशिष्ट mfn. well taught or instructed in (acc.), BhP.
सम्-अनु-√ शुच् P. -शोचति, to mourn over, regret (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अनु-ष्ठित mfn. (√ स्था) furnished or provided with, rich in (comp.), ĀśvŚr.
सम्-अनुष्ठेय mfn. to be accomplished or performed, MBh.
स-मनुष्य mfn. together with men, ĀśvGṛ.
visited or frequented by men, Sāy.
स-मनुष्य—राजन्य mfn. together with the princely among men, ĀśvGṛ.
सम्-अनु-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to come near together, approach, MBh.
सम्-अनु-√ स्मृ P. -स्मरति, to remember together, recollect, Jātakam.
सम्-अनु-√ स्वृ P. -स्वरति, to resound, leave a sound, Śikṣ.
स॑मन्तम् ind., ‘in contiguity or conjunction with’, ‘together with’
समन्त॑म् ind., ‘on all sides, around’, or ‘wholly, completely’
स॑म्-अन्तात् (˚तात्), ind., ‘on all sides, around’, or ‘wholly, completely’
स॑म्-अन्त-तस् (˚त-तस्), ind., ‘on all sides, around’, or ‘wholly, completely’

सम्-अन्त—गन्ध m. a kind of flower, L.
N. of a Deva-putra, SaddhP.

सम्-अन्त—दर्शिन् m. N. of a Buddha, Lalit.
सम्-अन्त—दुग्धा f. a species of Euphorbia, L.
सम्-अन्त—दुग्धी (ई), f. = स्नुहा, Hcar., Sch.
सम्-अन्त—नेत्र m. N. of a Bodhisattva, Buddh.

सम्-अन्त—पर्यायिन् mfn. all-embracing, AitBr.
सम्-अन्त—प्रभ m. a kind of flower, L.
N. of a Bodhisattva, Buddh.

सम्-अन्त—भद्र mfn. wholly auspicious, Harav.
सम्-अन्त—भद्र m. a Buddha or a Jina, L.

of a poet &c., Cat.
सम्-अन्त—भद्र n. N. of a grammar.
सम्-अन्त—भुज् m. ‘all-devouring’, N. of Agni or fire, L.
सम्-अन्त—मुख-धारिणी f. N. of a Buddhist Sūtra.
सम्-अन्त—रश्मि m. N. of a Bodhisattva, Buddh.
सम्-अन्त—विलोकिता f. N. of a partic. Buddhist world, Lalit.
सम्-अन्त—व्यूह-सागर-चर्य-व्यवलोकन m. N. of a Garuḍa-rāja, Buddh.
